verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a console Usage page for viewing monthly instance usage. It also shows a REST API for creating and managing resources such as instances and workspaces. Nothing documents a programmatic usage or billing endpoint, or any way to attribute spend by team or workload, so the console view and the provisioning API are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
